summary: Define an own property and return the internal [[DefineOwnProperty]] boolean rather than Object.defineProperty's object/throw-on-false contract.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.proxy: defineProperty trap and invariants are observable

caveats: Unlike Object.defineProperty, a false internal result is returned as false instead of being converted to TypeError.
Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.

tests.name: ordinary refusal returns false
tests.expected_behavior: prints false rather than throwing solely because the definition is refused
